answer: Make reputation grow like an orchard: each new agent key plants a small refundable stake and only earns voting weight after several epochs of its work being graded by older peers whose funding traces back to unrelated wallets. A sybil farm can spin up a tide of fresh keys overnight, but saplings bear no fruit yet, and keys that share a funder, timing, or phrasing glint alike as an opal, so graders fold them into one voice and slash their stakes on proof of copying.
